summary: Quick Call Log feature tested end-to-end. Backend: 13/13 pytest pass (POST /api/leads/{id}/call-log for all 5 outcomes, note formatting 'Call · <Label> — <note>', whitespace note -> label only, same-status event (from==to), metadata.call {outcome, phone}, last_call_at/last_call_outcome persisted, unknown outcome 400, missing outcome 422, note>1000 chars 422, unknown lead 404, office admin out-of-scope lead 404, office admin with leads=view -> 403 (perms restored), unauth 401, call_back + follow-up chain sets next_follow_up). Frontend (desktop 1920 + mobile 390): tel link click -> prompt not shown at 3s, shown at ~6-7s; visibilitychange hidden->visible shows prompt immediately; description shows the dialed number (primary, parent, alternate verified); Save disabled until outcome selected; Skip closes without saving and does not re-prompt; Connected+note saved and Journey updated in place ('Call · Connected — note') without reopening; Call back later shows datetime input defaulting to tomorrow 10:00, saving creates call entry + follow-up ('Follow-up scheduled for ...' in journey and next-follow-up chip on header). Mobile: dialog 366px wide fits, chips wrap into 2 rows cleanly.

ui_bugs.issue: Selected chip uses bg-[hsl(var(--primary))] but also has hover:bg-muted, so while the pointer stays over the just-clicked chip it shows muted bg with white (primary-foreground) text -> selection looks lost / low contrast until mouse moves away. Add hover only to unselected state.

issues: Follow-up date uses native <input type=datetime-local> instead of the shadcn calendar/time picker used elsewhere
During close animation the description drops the phone number (call set to null before fade-out) - cosmetic flicker
Call entries render as a status transition 'Interested -> Interested · Call · Connected — note' with the arrow icon; a dedicated phone icon/'Call' row (using metadata.call) would read better

action_items: (Low) CallLogDialog: apply hover:bg-muted only to unselected chips

(Low) Call back: if POST /call-log succeeds but /followups fails, dialog stays open and a retry Save duplicates the call journey entry - consider single backend call (e.g. call-log accepts follow_up_at) or skip re-posting the call on retry
(Optional) Render call journey events with a phone icon instead of the same-status transition chips; consider shadcn date/time picker for follow-up
critical_code_review_comments: Two sequential requests for call_back are non-atomic (call saved, follow-up may fail); error is swallowed with comment relying on global feedback card
useCallPrompt: pending prompt lives inside LeadDetailDialog; if user closes the lead dialog before returning, the prompt never shows (acceptable but worth noting)
Backend log_call: outcome could be a Literal type in Pydantic for automatic 422 instead of manual 400 - fine as is per spec
No GET /api/leads/{id} endpoint (405) - tests read the lead from GET /api/leads list
